answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies. By requiring agents to lock capital, the protocol ensures that identity creation incurs a non-trivial monetary cost, acting as a financial haven against spam. Just as a comet traces a path through the void, validators must prove they possess significant value. Like the high conductivity of copper wiring, this stake ensures efficient signaling, forcing an attacker to acquire majority capital at exorbitant expense.
